executive_summary.strategy_summary: Create a focused one-page portfolio positioning the user as a backend engineer who can implement reliable application and worker infrastructure. Lead with the PostgreSQL-backed job-processing work because it has the clearest personal contribution and strongest production relevance. Avoid unsupported scale, performance, leadership, and business-impact claims.
executive_summary.main_opportunity: The available evidence supports a coherent backend and production-reliability narrative.
executive_summary.main_limitation: Quantified outcomes and the user's exact contribution to one team project remain unavailable.

portfolio_goal.summary: Support applications for backend engineering roles by making production-oriented implementation evidence easy to evaluate.

career_stage.note: Do not translate this into a public seniority label unless the user explicitly chooses one.

positioning_strategy.positioning_direction: Present the user as a hands-on backend engineer whose strongest evidence is building reliable APIs, PostgreSQL-backed workflows, and operational safeguards rather than as a generalist claiming equal depth across every technology.

differentiators.statement: Experience implementing retry and stale-job recovery in a durable background-worker workflow.
Practical use of PostgreSQL for both application state and durable job coordination.

evidence_strengths: Clear implementation-level contribution on the durable worker.
Consistent backend technologies across work and projects.
credibility_boundaries: Do not use 'senior engineer' unless separately confirmed.
Do not describe the user as technical lead.
Do not state reliability, latency, throughput, adoption, or revenue improvements numerically.
Do not imply ownership of the full deployment platform.

recommended_section_priority.purpose: Establish backend role and production-reliability direction quickly.
Show implementation decisions and personal contribution.
Support the project evidence with professional context.
Group related capabilities rather than displaying an undifferentiated skill list.
Provide concise professional context without repeating the hero.
Offer a clear employment-oriented contact action.

content_density.reason: There is enough evidence for two meaningful project or systems stories, but not enough verified detail for a long case-study-heavy site.

featured_projects.selection_reason: This project has the strongest combination of personal contribution, backend relevance, failure-handling depth, and evidence quality.
featured_projects.supported_project_scope: A PostgreSQL-backed durable background-job system supporting queued work, retries, stale-job recovery, and worker status.
narrative_focus: Why durable background work was needed.
How job state and failure recovery were handled.

items_to_omit.item: Generic claims of expertise in every listed technology
items_to_omit.reason: Technology presence does not establish equal depth.

tone.explanation: The target audience and strongest evidence favor clear technical language over highly promotional copy.

voice_rules: Prefer concrete responsibilities and decisions over adjectives.
Avoid exaggerated terms such as expert, world-class, or industry-leading.
Keep team outcomes distinct from personal actions.

theme_preference.explanation: Choose a professional technical direction later without assuming dark mode.

motion_preference.explanation: Motion may support hierarchy but must not delay access to professional content.

cta_and_contact.primary_cta_intent: Invite discussion about backend engineering opportunities.
cta_and_contact.secondary_cta_intent: Offer access to selected public project or source links where available.

private_or_omitted_contact.reason: Present in the resume but not explicitly approved for publication.

unresolved_items.summary: Quantified outcomes are unavailable for the portfolio.
unresolved_items.downstream_behavior: Do not invent numeric results; keep claims qualitative.

content_architect.central_story: A backend engineer building reliable application and worker systems with practical attention to failure handling and data-backed coordination.
writing_constraints: Do not invent scale or outcomes.
Do not describe team work as personal ownership.
Do not use unsupported seniority language.

visual_design_director.desired_impression: Technically credible, production-aware, organized, and direct.
content_implications: The worker project deserves the strongest visual and narrative emphasis.
The content does not support decorative statistics.
A balanced-density one-page portfolio is appropriate.
presentation_constraints: Do not rely on fake product screenshots.
Preserve immediate readability and reduced-motion behavior.

universal_constraints: Preserve proper nouns and technology names.
Keep output in English unless the user changes the language.
Do not publish private contact information.
Do not introduce claims outside the approved fact registry.

decision_log.decision: Primary target role set to Backend Engineer
Tone set to technical and direct
